Figure 2:Outcome criteria and evaluators.𝒥R\mathcal{J}_{\mathrm{R}}uses explicit
trace evidence.𝒥L\mathcal{J}_{\mathrm{L}}reads the complete trace and the stated task-specific
criterion. A sink call can support either full success or partial compliance.

Figure 3:A.I.G runtime adapter for DSH.A.I.G prepares a tainted
artifact and controlled fixture files. The real DSH TypeScript runtime handles
the agent turn. The adapter converts DSH session events into a trace for𝒥R\mathcal{J}_{\mathrm{R}}and𝒥L\mathcal{J}_{\mathrm{L}}.

Figure 4:DSH source-to-sink path.A tool result can become
model-visible context, after which the model may select another tool. DSH also
exposes pre-execution and deny-only guard hooks that a deployment can use to
block risky calls.

Figure 5:Dataset composition.The base dataset balances 16 channels,
two carrier modes, and 35 payload objectives. The attack suite usesnaiveas an unmodified baseline and compares it with 12 attack methods.
